1795bool XSTRING::DeleteCharacters(XDWORD index, XDWORD ncharacteres)
1796{
1797 if(!ncharacteres) return true;
1798 if(IsEmpty()) return false;
1799
1800 if(index >= size) return false;
1801
1802 int nchar = ncharacteres;
1803 if((index + nchar) > size) nchar = (int)size-index;
1804
1805 int c = index;
1806 while(text[c+nchar])
1807 {
1808 text[c] = text[c+nchar];
1809 c++;
1810 }
1811 text[c] = text[c + nchar];
1812
1813 return ReAllocBuffer(size - nchar);
1814}

1828bool XSTRING::DeleteCharactersToEnd(XDWORD index)
1829{

1831

1833
1834 int nchar = (int)size-index;
1835 int c = index;
1836
1837 while(text[c+nchar])
1838 {
1839 text[c] = text[c+nchar];
1840 c++;
1841 }
1842 text[c] = text[c + nchar];
1843
1844 return ReAllocBuffer(size - nchar);
1845}

1847
1860bool XSTRING::DeleteCharacter(XCHAR character,XSTRINGCONTEXT context)
1861{
1862 if(IsEmpty()) return false;
1863
1864 switch(context)
1865 {
1866 case XSTRINGCONTEXT_FROM_FIRST : { XDWORD n=0;
1867 while(character == text[n] && n<size)
1868 {
1869 n++;
1870 }
1871 if(n) DeleteCharacters(0,n);
1872 }
1873 break;
1874
1875 case XSTRINGCONTEXT_TO_END : { XDWORD n=size-1;
1876 while(character == text[n] && n)
1877 {
1878 n--;
1879 }
1880
1881 if(size!=n+1) ReAllocBuffer(n+1);
1882 }
1883 break;
1884
1885 case XSTRINGCONTEXT_ALLSTRING : { XDWORD c = 0;
1886 XDWORD a = 0;
1887
1888 while (c < size)
1889 {
1890 while(text[c]==character)
1891 {
1892 c++;
1893 }
1894
1895 text[a] = text[c];
1896 c++;
1897
1898 if(!text[a]) break;
1899 a++;
1900 }
1901
1902 ReAllocBuffer(a);
1903 size = a;
1904 }
1905 break;
1906 }
1907
1908 return true;
1909}

1923bool XSTRING::DeleteNoCharacters(XSTRINGCONTEXT context)
1924{
1925 bool status = DeleteCharacter(__C('\x09'),context);
1926
1927 if(status) status = DeleteCharacter(__C('\x0A'),context);
1928 if(status) status = DeleteCharacter(__C('\x0D'),context);
1929 if(status) status = DeleteCharacter(__C('\x20'),context);
1930
1931 return status;
1932}
1933
1934
1948int XSTRING::DeleteNoCharacters(XCHAR* n, int start, XSTRINGCONTEXT context)
1949{
1950 int a= 0;
1951
1952 XSTRING needle;
1953 needle.Set(n);
1954
1955 if(!this->GetSize()) return 0;
1956
1957 switch(context)
1958 {
1959 case XSTRINGCONTEXT_FROM_FIRST : { XDWORD n;
1960 for(n=start; n<size; n++)
1961 {
1962 XCHAR character = text[n];
1963 bool found = false;
1964
1965 for(XDWORD e=0; needle.Get()[e] != __C('\0'); e++)
1966 {
1967 if(character == needle.Get()[e])
1968 {
1969 found = true;
1970 break;
1971 }
1972 }
1973
1974 if(!found) break;
1975 }
1976
1977 this->DeleteCharacters(0, n);
1978 return n;
1979 }
1980 //break;
1981
1982 case XSTRINGCONTEXT_TO_END : { int n;
1983 for(n = size- start-1; n >=0; n--)
1984 {
1985 XCHAR character = text[n];
1986 bool found = false;
1987
1988 for(XDWORD e = 0; needle.Get()[e] != __C('\0'); e++)
1989 {
1990 if(character == needle.Get()[e])
1991 {
1992 found = true;
1993 break;
1994 }
1995 }
1996
1997 if(!found) break;
1998 }
1999 this->DeleteCharacters(n+1, size -1 - n);
2000 return n;
2001 }
2002 //break;
2003
2004 case XSTRINGCONTEXT_ALLSTRING : { for(XDWORD n = start; n < size; n++)
2005 {
2006 XCHAR character = text[n];
2007 bool found = false;
2008
2009 for(XDWORD e=0; needle.Get()[e] != __C('\0'); e++)
2010 {
2011 if(character == needle.Get()[e])
2012 {
2013 found = true;
2014 break;
2015 }
2016 }
2017
2018 if(found) continue;
2019
2020 text[a] = character;
2021 a++;
2022 }
2023
2024 text[a] = __C('\0');
2025
2026 this->AdjustSize();
2027
2028 return 1;
2029 }
2030 //break;
2031
2032 }
2033
2034 return 0;
2035}

2062bool XSTRING::DeleteLastZeros()
2063{
2064 int index = GetSize()-1;
2065 bool status = false;
2066
2067 if(index <= 0)
2068 {
2069 return false;
2070 }
2071
2072 while(Character_GetLast () == __C('0'))
2073 {
2074 DeleteLastCharacter();
2075 status = true;
2076 }
2077
2078 return status;
2079}

2136bool XSTRING::Character_IsLowerCase(XCHAR character)

2462int XSTRING::Compare(const XCHAR* string, int csize, bool ignorecase)
2463{
2464 XDWORD stringsize = csize;
2465
2466 if(size != stringsize)
2467 {
2468 if(size>stringsize) return 1;
2469 if(size<stringsize) return -1;
2470 }
2471
2472 if(!size && !stringsize) return 0;
2473
2474 XCHAR* _text = (XCHAR*)string;
2475 if(!_text)
2476 {
2477 return -1;
2478 }
2479
2480 if(!_text[0])
2481 {
2482 return -1;
2483 }
2484
2485 int index = size-1;
2486
2487 while(index >= 0)
2488 {
2489 if(ignorecase)
2490 {
2491 XCHAR a = _text[index];
2492 XCHAR b = text[index];
2493
2494 if(Character_IsAlpha(a))
2495 {
2496 XCHAR c1 = Character_ToUpper(a);
2497 XCHAR c2 = Character_ToUpper(b);
2498
2499 if(c1 < c2) return 1;
2500 if(c1 > c2) return -1;
2501 }
2502 else
2503 {
2504 if(a < b) return 1;
2505 if(a > b) return -1;
2506 }
2507 }
2508 else
2509 {
2510 if(_text[index] < text[index]) return 1;
2511 if(_text[index] > text[index]) return -1;
2512 }
2513
2514 index--;
2515 }
2516
2517 return 0;
2518}

2690int XSTRING::Find(XSTRING& string, bool ignorecase,int startindex)
2691{
2692 if(IsEmpty()) return XSTRING_NOTFOUND;
2693 if(string.IsEmpty()) return XSTRING_NOTFOUND;
2694
2695 XCHAR* _text = string.Get();
2696 XDWORD _size = string.GetSize();
2697
2698 if(_size > size) return XSTRING_NOTFOUND;
2699 if(startindex>=(int)(size-_size)+1) return XSTRING_NOTFOUND;
2700 if(startindex<0) return XSTRING_NOTFOUND;
2701
2702 bool found;
2703
2704 for(XDWORD c=startindex;c<(size-_size)+1;c++)
2705 {
2706 found = true;
2707
2708 for(XDWORD d=0;d<_size;d++)
2709 {
2710 if(ignorecase && Character_IsAlpha(_text[d]))
2711 {
2712 XCHAR c1 = Character_ToUpper(_text[d]);
2713 XCHAR c2 = Character_ToUpper(text[c+d]);
2714
2715 if(c1!=c2)
2716 {
2717 found = false;
2718 break;
2719 }
2720 }
2721 else
2722 {
2723 if(_text[d]!=text[c+d])
2724 {
2725 found = false;
2726 break;
2727 }
2728 }
2729 }
2730
2731 if(found) return c;
2732 }
2733
2734 return XSTRING_NOTFOUND;
2735}

2758 {

2760 }

2762 else
2763 {
2764 for(XDWORD c=startindex; c<size; c++)
2765 {
2766 if(text[c] == character) return c;
2767 }
2768 }
2769
2770 return XSTRING_NOTFOUND;

2931int XSTRING::Copy(const XCHAR* startmark, const XCHAR* endmark, bool ignorecase, int addstartindex, XSTRING& string)
2932{

2935 XDWORD sizeendmark = 0;

2937 string.Empty();
2938
2939 if(startmark)
2940 {
2941 XSTRING mark;
2942
2943 mark = startmark;
2944 startindex = Find(startmark, ignorecase, addstartindex);
2945 if(startindex==XSTRING_NOTFOUND) return XSTRING_NOTFOUND;
2946
2947 startindex+= mark.GetSize();
2948 }
2949
2950 if(endmark)
2951 {
2952 XSTRING mark;
2953
2954 mark = endmark;
2955 endindex = Find(endmark, ignorecase, startindex);
2956 if(endindex==XSTRING_NOTFOUND) endindex = size;
2957
2958 sizeendmark = mark.GetSize();
2959 }
2960
2961 for(int c=startindex;c<endindex;c++)
2962 {
2963 XCHAR str[2] = { text[c], 0 };
2964
2965 string+=str;
2966 }
2967
2968 int indexnext = (endindex+sizeendmark);
2969
2970 if(indexnext>(int)size) indexnext = (int)size;
2971
2972 return indexnext;
2973}

3621bool XSTRING::ConvertHexFormatChars()
3622{
3623 XSTRING string;
3624
3625 string.Empty();
3626
3627 if(IsEmpty()) return false;
3628
3629 for(int c=0;c<(int)GetSize();c++)
3630 {
3631 XCHAR character[3] = { 0 , 0 , 0 };
3632
3633 character[0] = Get()[c];
3634 character[1] = Get()[c+1];
3635
3636 if((character[0]==__C('\\')) && (character[1]==__C('x')))
3637 {
3638 XSTRING numberhex;
3639 XCHAR part[2] = { 0 , 0 };
3640
3641 c+=2;
3642
3643 for(int d=0;d<2;d++)
3644 {
3645 part[0] = Get()[c+d];
3646 numberhex.Add(part);
3647 }
3648
3649 numberhex.UnFormat(__L("%02X"),&part[0]);
3650
3651 part[0]&=0x00FF;
3652 string.Add(part);
3653
3654 c++;
3655 }
3656 else string.Add((XCHAR)character[0]);
3657 }
3658
3659 if(string.IsEmpty()) return false;
3660
3661 Set(string);
3662
3663 return true;
3664}

4461bool XSTRING::ConvertFromXBuffer(XBUFFER& xbuffer, XSTRINGCODING buffercoding)
4462{
4463 bool status = false;
4464
4465 if(xbuffer.IsEmpty()) return false;
4466
4467 Empty();
4468
4469 switch(GetTypeCoding())
4470 {
4471 case XSTRINGCODING_UTF16 : switch(buffercoding)
4472 {
4473 case XSTRINGCODING_UNKWOWN :
4474 case XSTRINGCODING_ASCII :
4475 { xbuffer.ResetPosition();
4476
4477 for(XDWORD c=0; c<xbuffer.GetSize(); c++)
4478 {
4479 XBYTE character;
4480
4481 xbuffer.Get(character);
4482 Add((XCHAR)character);
4483 }
4484 }
4485 status = true;
4486 break;
4487
4488 case XSTRINGCODING_UTF8 : ConvertFromUTF8(xbuffer);
4489 status = true;
4490 break;
4491
4492 case XSTRINGCODING_UTF16 : { xbuffer.ResetPosition();
4493
4494 for(XDWORD c=0; c<xbuffer.GetSize(); c++)
4495 {
4496 XWORD character;
4497
4498 xbuffer.Get(character);
4499 Add((XCHAR)character);
4500 }
4501 }
4502 status = true;
4503 break;
4504
4505 case XSTRINGCODING_UTF32 : { xbuffer.ResetPosition();
4506
4507 for(size_t c=0; c<xbuffer.GetSize(); c++)
4508 {
4509 XDWORD value = 0;
4510
4511 xbuffer.Get(value);
4512 if (value > 0xFFFF)
4513 {
4514 value -= 0x10000;
4515
4516 //XDWORD lo = ((XWORD)(0xD800 | (value >> 10)));
4517 //XDWORD hi = ((XWORD)(0xDC00 | (value & 0x3FF)));
4518
4519 //XCHAR character = ((hi<<16) | lo);
4520 //Add((XCHAR)character);
4521
4522 Add((XCHAR)(0xD800 | (value >> 10)));
4523 Add((XCHAR)(0xDC00 | (value & 0x3FF)));
4524 }
4525 else
4526 {
4527 Add((XCHAR)value);
4528 }
4529 }
4530 }
4531 status = true;
4532 break;
4533
4534 }
4535 break;
4536
4537 case XSTRINGCODING_UTF32 : switch(buffercoding)
4538 {
4539 case XSTRINGCODING_UNKWOWN :
4540 case XSTRINGCODING_ASCII : { xbuffer.ResetPosition();
4541
4542 for(XDWORD c=0; c<xbuffer.GetSize(); c++)
4543 {
4544 XBYTE character;
4545
4546 xbuffer.Get(character);
4547 Add((XCHAR)character);
4548 }
4549 }
4550 status = true;
4551 break;
4552
4553 case XSTRINGCODING_UTF8 : ConvertFromUTF8(xbuffer);
4554 status = true;
4555 break;
4556
4557 case XSTRINGCODING_UTF16 : { xbuffer.ResetPosition();
4558
4559 for(size_t c=0; c<xbuffer.GetSize(); c++)
4560 {
4561 XWORD value;
4562 xbuffer.Get(value);
4563
4564 if(value >= 0xD800 && value <= 0xDBFF && c + 1 < xbuffer.GetSize())
4565 {
4566 XWORD low;
4567 xbuffer.Get(low);
4568
4569 if(low >= 0xDC00 && low <= 0xDFFF)
4570 {
4571 XDWORD value2 = ((value - 0xD800) << 10) + (low - 0xDC00) + 0x10000;
4572 Add((XCHAR)value2);
4573 c++;
4574 }
4575 else
4576 {
4577 Add((XCHAR)value);
4578 }
4579 }
4580 else
4581 {
4582 Add((XCHAR)value);
4583 }
4584 }
4585 }
4586 status = true;
4587 break;
4588
4589 case XSTRINGCODING_UTF32 : { xbuffer.ResetPosition();
4590
4591 for(XDWORD c=0; c<xbuffer.GetSize(); c++)
4592 {
4593 XDWORD character;
4594
4595 xbuffer.Get(character);
4596 Add((XCHAR)character);
4597 }
4598 }
4599 status = true;
4600 break;
4601
4602 }
4603 break;
4604
4605 default : break;
4606 }
4607
4608 return status;
4609}

4729bool XSTRING::ConvertFromUTF8(XBYTE* data, XDWORD size)
4730{
4731 XDWORD sizeutf8 = 0;
4732 XDWORD index = 0;
4733 XBYTE* ptr;
4734 XDWORD c;
4735
4736 c = 0;
4737 ptr = data;
4738 while(c<size)
4739 {
4740 if(((XBYTE)*ptr)<128 || (*ptr&192)==192) sizeutf8++;
4741 ptr++;
4742 c++;
4743 }
4744
4745 if(!sizeutf8) return false;
4746
4747 if(sizeutf8>size) sizeutf8 = size;
4748
4749 if(!ReAllocBuffer(sizeutf8)) return false;
4750
4751 c = 0;
4752 ptr = data;
4753 while(c < size)
4754 {
4755 XBYTE b=*ptr;
4756 //Byte represents an ASCII character. Direct copy will do.
4757 if(!(b&128))
4758 {
4759 text[index]=b;
4760 }
4761 else
4762 {
4763 //Byte is the middle of an encoded character. Ignore.
4764 if((b&192)==128)
4765 {
4766 ptr++;
4767 continue;
4768 }
4769 else
4770 {
4771 //Byte represents the start of an encoded character in the range
4772 //U+0080 to U+07FF
4773 if((b&224)==192)
4774 {
4775 text[index]=((*ptr&31)<<6)|(ptr[1]&63);
4776 }
4777 else
4778 {
4779 //Byte represents the start of an encoded character in the range
4780 //U+07FF to U+FFFF
4781 if((b&240)==224)
4782 {
4783 text[index]=((*ptr&15)<<12)|((ptr[1]&63)<<6)|(ptr[2]&63);
4784 }
4785 else
4786 {
4787 //Byte represents the start of an encoded character beyond the
4788 //U+FFFF limit of 16-bit integers
4789 if((b&248)==240)
4790 {
4791 text[index]='?';
4792 }
4793 }
4794 }
4795 }
4796 }
4797
4798 index++;
4799 ptr++;
4800 c++;
4801
4802 if(index >= sizeutf8)
4803 {
4804 break;
4805 }
4806 }
4807
4808 return true;
4809}

4842bool XSTRING::ConvertToUTF8(XBYTE* data, int& size, bool addzeroatend)
4843{
4844 size = 0;
4845 if(!data) return false;
4846
4847 if(IsEmpty()) return false;
4848
4849 int i = 0;
4850 int j = 0;
4851 int c = (int)text[i++];
4852
4853 while(c)
4854 {
4855 if(c<0)
4856 {
4857 data[j++]=1;
4858 }
4859 else
4860 {
4861 if(c<128)
4862 {
4863 data[j++] = (XBYTE)c;
4864 }
4865 else
4866 {
4867 if(c< 2048)
4868 {
4869 data[j++]= (XBYTE)(192+ c/64);
4870 data[j++]= (XBYTE)(128+(c&63));
4871 }
4872 else
4873 {
4874 if(c<65536)
4875 {
4876 data[j++]= (XBYTE)(224+ c/4096);
4877 data[j++]= (XBYTE)(128+(c&4095)/64);
4878 data[j++]= (XBYTE)(128+(c&63));
4879 }
4880 else
4881 {
4882 data[j++]= (XBYTE)(240+ c/262144);
4883 data[j++]= (XBYTE)(128+(c&262143)/4096);
4884 data[j++]= (XBYTE)(128+(c&4095)/64);
4885 data[j++]= (XBYTE)(128+(c&63));
4886 }
4887
4888
4889 }
4890 }
4891 }
4892
4893 c = text[i++];
4894 }
4895
4896 if(addzeroatend)
4897 {
4898 data[j]=0;
4899 }
4900 else
4901 {
4902 j--;
4903 }
4904
4905 size = j;
4906

5274 else if(integerpart == 70) Set(__L("setenta"));

5276 else if(integerpart == 90) Set(__L("noventa"));
5277 else if(integerpart < 100)
5278 {
5279 ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(Truncate(integerpart/10) * 10, true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5280 Add(__L(" y "));
5281 tmp.ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(fmod(integerpart, (double)10), true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);

5284 else if(integerpart == 100) Set(__L("cien"));

5289 Add(tmp);
5290 }
5291 else if((integerpart == 200) || (integerpart == 300) || (integerpart == 400) || (integerpart == 600) || (integerpart == 800))
5292 {
5293 ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(Truncate(integerpart / 100), true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5294 Add(__L("cientos"));
5295 }
5296 else if(integerpart == 500) Set(__L("quinientos"));
5297 else if(integerpart == 700) Set(__L("setecientos"));
5298 else if(integerpart == 900) Set(__L("novecientos"));
5299 else if(integerpart < 1000)
5300 {
5301 ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(Truncate(integerpart / 100) * 100, true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5302 Add(__L(" "));
5303 tmp.ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(fmod(integerpart, (double)100), true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5304 Add(tmp);
5305 }
5306 else if(integerpart == 1000) Set(__L("mil"));
5307 else if(integerpart < 2000)
5308 {
5309 Set(__L("mil "));
5310 tmp.ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(fmod(integerpart, (double)1000), true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5311 Add(tmp);
5312 }
5313 else if(integerpart < 1000000)
5314 {
5315 ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(Truncate(integerpart / 1000), true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5316 Add(__L(" mil"));
5317 if((fmod(integerpart, (double)1000)) > 0)
5318 {
5319 Add(" ");
5320 tmp.ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(fmod(integerpart, (double)1000), true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5321 Add(tmp);
5322 }
5323 }
5324 else if(integerpart == 1000000) Set(__L("un millon"));
5325 else if(integerpart < 2000000)
5326 {
5327 Set(__L("un millon"));
5328 tmp.ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(fmod(integerpart, (double)1000000), true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5329 Add(tmp);
5330 }
5331 else if(integerpart < 1000000000000LL)
5332 {
5333 ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText((integerpart / 1000000), true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5334 Add(__L(" millones"));
5335 if((integerpart - Truncate(integerpart / 1000000) * 1000000) > 0)
5336 {
5337 Add(__L(" "));
5338 tmp.ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(integerpart - Truncate(integerpart / 1000000) * 1000000, true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5339 Add(tmp);
5340 }
5341 }
5342 else
5343 {
5344 if(integerpart == 1000000000000LL) Set(__L("un billon"));
5345 else if(integerpart < 2000000000000LL)
5346 {
5347 Set(__L("un billon"));
5348 tmp.ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(Truncate(integerpart / 1000000000000LL) * 1000000000000LL, true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5349 Add(tmp);
5350 }
5351 else
5352 {
5353 ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(Truncate(integerpart / 1000000000000LL), true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5354 Add(__L(" billones"));
5355
5356 if((integerpart - Truncate(integerpart / 1000000000000LL) * 1000000000000LL) > 0)
5357 {
5358 Add(__L(" "));
5359 tmp.ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(integerpart - Truncate(integerpart / 1000000000000LL) * 1000000000000LL, true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5360 Add(tmp);
5361 }
5362 }
5363 }
5364 if(!integerpart) return false;
5365 }
5366
5367 if(withdecimalpart)
5368 {
5369 double _integerpart;
5370 double _decimalpart;
5371
5372 double ipart = Truncate(decimalpart*100);
5373 double dpart = Fraction(decimalpart*100);
5374
5375 if(dpart>=0.9f) ipart++;
5376
5377 if(ipart)
5378 {
5379 if(withintegerpart) Add(__L(" con "));
5380 tmp.ConvertFromDoubleToSpanishText(ipart, true, false, _integerpart, _decimalpart);
5381 Add(tmp);
5382
5383 } else return false;
5384 }
5385
5386 return true;
5387
5388 #else
5389 return false;
5390 #endif
5391}

5433bool XSTRING::Split(XCHAR separator, XVECTOR<XSTRING*>& results, bool addsubstringempty)

5441 if((text[c] == separator) || (!text[c]))

5443 XSTRING* string = GEN_NEW XSTRING();
5444 if(string)
5445 {
5446 Copy(start, (*string));
5447
5448 for(XDWORD d=0; d<string->GetSize(); d++)

5459 if(addsubstringempty)
5460 {

5462 results.Add(string);

5468 results.Add(string);

5470 }
5471
5472 start = c+1;
5473
5474 if((XDWORD)start >= size) break;
5475 }
5476 }
5477 }
5478

5496bool XSTRING::FormatArg(const XCHAR* mask, va_list* arg, bool isspecialweb)
5497{
5498 XSTRING str;
5499 bool openlabel = false;
5500
5501 Empty();
5502
5503 if(!mask) return false;
5504
5505 int c = 0;
5506
5507 XCHAR* param = GEN_NEW XCHAR[16];
5508 if(param)
5509 {
5510 while(mask[c])
5511 {
5512 switch(mask[c])
5513 {
5514 case __C('%') : { int nparam = 1;
5515 bool end = false;
5516
5517 memset(param,0, 16*sizeof(XCHAR));
5518 param[0] = __C('%');
5519
5520 c++;
5521
5522 do{ param[nparam] = mask[c];
5523
5524 nparam++;
5525
5526 switch(mask[c])
5527 {
5528 case __C('c') :
5529 case __C('C') : { XCHAR character;
5530
5531 #if defined(LINUX) || defined(ANDROID) || defined(MICROCONTROLLER)
5532 character = (XCHAR)va_arg((*arg), XDWORD);
5533 #else
5534 character = (XCHAR)va_arg((*arg), int /*XCHAR*/);
5535 #endif
5536
5537 str.Set(character);
5538 end = true ;
5539 }
5540 break;
5541
5542 case __C('i') :
5543 case __C('o') :
5544 case __C('x') :
5545 case __C('X') : { bool large = false;
5546 for(int l=0; l<(int)XSTRING::GetSize(param); l++)
5547 {
5548 if(param[l] == __C('l')) large = true;
5549 }
5550
5551 if(!large)
5552 {
5553 int value = (int)va_arg((*arg), int);
5554
5555 str.ConvertFromInt(value, param);
5556 }
5557 else
5558 {
5559 str.ConvertFromLongLong((long long)va_arg((*arg), long long), param);
5560 }
5561 end = true;
5562 }
5563 break;
5564
5565 case __C('d') :
5566 case __C('u') : { bool large = false;
5567 bool shortint = false;
5568
5569 for(int d=0; d<(int)XSTRING::GetSize(param); d++)
5570 {
5571 if(param[d] == __C('l'))
5572 {
5573 large = true;
5574 }
5575
5576 if(param[d] == __C('h'))
5577 {
5578 shortint = true;
5579 }
5580 }
5581
5582 if(shortint)
5583 {
5584 if(mask[c] == __C('d'))
5585 {
5586 short value = (short)va_arg((*arg), int);
5587 str.ConvertFromShort(value, param);
5588 end = true;
5589 }
5590
5591 if(mask[c] == __C('u'))
5592 {
5593 XWORD value = (XWORD)va_arg((*arg), int);
5594 str.ConvertFromWord(value, param);
5595 end = true;
5596 }
5597 }
5598
5599 if((!shortint) && (!large))
5600 {
5601 if(mask[c] == __C('d'))
5602 {
5603 int value = (int)va_arg((*arg), int);
5604 str.ConvertFromInt(value, param);
5605 end = true;
5606 }
5607
5608 if(mask[c] == __C('u'))
5609 {
5610 XDWORD value = (XDWORD)va_arg((*arg), int);
5611 str.ConvertFromDWord(value, param);
5612 end = true;
5613 }
5614 }
5615
5616 if(large)
5617 {

5699 break;
5700
5701 case __C('\x0') : end = true;

5704 default : break;
5705 }

5707 c++;
5708
5709 } while(!end);

5711 break;

5714 XCHAR character[2]={ mask[c], 0 };

5716 c++;
5717 }
5718 break;
5719
5720 case __C('>') : { openlabel = false;
5721 XCHAR character[2]={ mask[c], 0 };

5748 c++;

5763 Add(str);

5765

5767 }
5768
5769 return true;

6055 end = true;

6057 break;
6058
6059 case __C('%') : end = true;
6060 break;
6061
6062 case __C('[') : inbrackets = true;

6097 //if(text[indextext] ==__C(' ')) indextext++;

6166bool XSTRING::AdjustSize(XDWORD size, bool ahead, XCHAR* characters, bool addstring)
6167{
6168 if(this->size == size) return false;
6169
6170 int diference;
6171
6172 if(this->size > size)
6173 {
6174 diference = (this->size- size);
6175 DeleteCharacters(size,diference);
6176 }
6177 else
6178 {
6179 if(characters)
6180 {
6181 if(ahead)
6182 {
6183 XSTRING string;
6184
6185 diference = (size-this->size);
6186 for(int c=0;c<diference;c++)
6187 {
6188 if(addstring) string.Add(characters); else string.Add(characters[0]);
6189 }
6190
6191 string+=Get();
6192
6193 Set(string);
6194
6195 }
6196 else
6197 {
6198 diference = ((size)-this->size);
6199 for(int c=0;c<diference;c++)
6200 {
6201 if(addstring) Add(characters); else Add(characters[0]);
6202 }
6203 }
6204 }
6205 else
6206 {
6207 diference = ((size)-this->size);
6208
6209 ReAllocBuffer(size);
6210 if(ahead)
6211 {
6212 for(int c=0;c<diference;c++)
6213 {
6214 text[c+diference] = text[c];
6215 text[c] = __C('-');
6216 }
6217 }
6218 }
6219 }
6220
6221 return true;
6222}

6286bool XSTRING::Explode(XCHAR token, XVECTOR<XSTRING*>* receive)
6287{
6288 int start = 0;
6289
6290 do{ int end = FindCharacter(token,start);
6291 if(end==XSTRING_NOTFOUND) end = size;
6292
6293 if((end-start)>0)
6294 {
6295 XSTRING* tok=GEN_NEW XSTRING();
6296 if(!tok) return false;
6297
6298 Copy(start, end, (*tok));
6299
6300 if(!receive->Add(tok))
6301 {
6302 delete(tok);
6303 return false;
6304 }
6305 }
6306
6307 start=end+1;
6308
6309 } while(start < (int)size);
6310
6311 return true;
6312}

6326bool XSTRING::GetTypeOfLineEnd(XSTRING& lineend)
6327{
6328 //----------------
6329 // \n x 0
6330 // \r x 1
6331 // \n \r 2
6332 // \r \n 3
6333
6334 int combinations[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
6335
6336 if(GetSize()<2) return false;
6337
6338 for(XDWORD c=0; c<GetSize()-1; c++)
6339 {
6340 if(Get()[c] == __C('\n'))
6341 {
6342 if(Get()[c+1] == __C('\r'))
6343 {
6344 combinations[2]++;
6345 c+=2;
6346
6347 } else combinations[0]++;
6348 }
6349 else
6350 {
6351 if(Get()[c] == __C('\r'))
6352 {
6353 if(Get()[c+1] == __C('\n'))
6354 {
6355 combinations[3]++;
6356 c+=2;
6357 }
6358 else combinations[1]++;
6359 }
6360 }
6361 }
6362
6363 if((combinations[0] >= combinations[1]) && (combinations[0] >= combinations[2]) && (combinations[0] >= combinations[3]))
6364 {
6365 lineend = __L("\n");
6366 }
6367 else
6368 {
6369 if((combinations[1] >= combinations[0]) && (combinations[1] >= combinations[2]) && (combinations[1] >= combinations[3]))
6370 {
6371 lineend = __L("\r");
6372 }
6373 else
6374 {
6375 if((combinations[2] >= combinations[0]) && (combinations[2] >= combinations[1]) && (combinations[2] >= combinations[3]))
6376 {
6377 lineend = __L("\n\r");
6378 }
6379 else
6380 {
6381 if((combinations[3] >= combinations[0]) && (combinations[3] >= combinations[1]) && (combinations[3] >= combinations[2]))
6382 {
6383 lineend = __L("\r\n");
6384 }
6385 }
6386 }
6387 }
6388
6389 return lineend.GetSize()?true:false;
6390}

6537void XSTRING::Base64_EncodeBlock(XBYTE *in, XBYTE *out, int len)
6538{
6539 out[0] = (XBYTE) codetablebase64[ (int)(in[0] >> 2) ];
6540 out[1] = (XBYTE) codetablebase64[ (int)(((in[0] & 0x03) << 4) | ((in[1] & 0xf0) >> 4)) ];
6541 out[2] = (XBYTE) (len > 1 ? codetablebase64[ (int)(((in[1] & 0x0f) << 2) | ((in[2] & 0xc0) >> 6)) ] : '=');
6542 out[3] = (XBYTE) (len > 2 ? codetablebase64[ (int)(in[2] & 0x3f) ] : '=');
6543}

6559bool XSTRING::Base64_Encode(XBYTE* buffer, XDWORD buffersize, XSTRING& line)
6560{
6561 XBYTE in[3] = { 0 };
6562 XBYTE out[4] = { 0 };
6563 int i;
6564 int len;
6565 int cin = 0;
6566
6567 *in = (XBYTE) 0;
6568 *out = (XBYTE) 0;
6569
6570 while((XDWORD)cin < buffersize)
6571 {
6572 len = 0;
6573 for(i = 0; i < 3; i++)
6574 {
6575 in[i] = (XBYTE)buffer[cin++];
6576
6577 if((XDWORD)cin <= buffersize)
6578 {
6579 len++;
6580 }
6581 else
6582 {
6583 in[i] = (XBYTE)0;
6584 }
6585 }
6586
6587 if(len > 0)
6588 {
6589 Base64_EncodeBlock(in, out, len );
6590 line.Add(out, 4);
6591 }
6592 }
6593
6594 return true;

6608void XSTRING::Base64_DecodeBlock(XBYTE in[4], XBYTE out[3])
6609{
6610 out[0] = (XBYTE)(in[0] << 2 | in[1] >> 4);
6611 out[1] = (XBYTE)(in[1] << 4 | in[2] >> 2);
6612 out[2] = (XBYTE)(((in[2] << 6) & 0xc0) | in[3]);

6629bool XSTRING::Base64_Decode(const char* in_buffer, int in_buffer_size, XBUFFER& outbuffer)
6630{
6631 XBYTE in[4];
6632 XBYTE out[3];
6633 XBYTE v;
6634 int i;
6635 int len;
6636 const char* ptr = in_buffer;
6637
6638 while (ptr <= in_buffer + in_buffer_size)
6639 {
6640 for(len = 0, i = 0; i < 4 && (ptr <= in_buffer + in_buffer_size); i++)
6641 {
6642 v = 0;
6643 while((ptr <= in_buffer + in_buffer_size) && v == 0)
6644 {
6645 v = (XBYTE)ptr[0];
6646 ptr++;
6647 v = (XBYTE)((v < 43 || v > 122) ? 0 : decodetablebase64[v - 43]);
6648 if(v) v = (XBYTE)((v == '$') ? 0 : v - 61);
6649 }
6650
6651 if(ptr <= in_buffer + in_buffer_size)
6652 {
6653 len++;
6654 if(v) in[i] = (XBYTE)(v - 1);
6655 }
6656 else
6657 {
6658 in[i] = 0;
6659 }
6660 }
6661
6662 if(len)
6663 {
6664 Base64_DecodeBlock(in, out);
6665
6666 for(i = 0; i < len - 1; i++)
6667 {
6668 outbuffer.Add(out[i]);
6669 }
6670 }
6671 }
6672
6673 return outbuffer.GetSize()?true:false;
6674}
